At audit time the working tree matched that commit exactly (git status showed no modification to any catalogue, ledger or receipt), so the bytes audited here are the committed bytes. This run wrote only receipts, its evidence records and the ledger rows, and those rows only through scripts/i18n/ledger-assemble.mjs.

auditors.actual_model_note: The run started on anthropic/claude-opus-5-5 and was switched to radient/auto by provider quota before this audit began; the receipt and this record name the model that actually executed.

immutable_receipt_notes: CO-B4 cites the sentence span as team-bridge-member-events.tsx:144-151; the span opens at line 144 and its className ("min-w-0 truncate") is at line 150, i.e. 144-151. The class and file are right and no claim depends on the offset.

checks.placeholders: {actor} x1 and {targets} x1, the same argument sequence as English; no ICU plural/select/number/date/tag nodes in any of the eight values, so no CLDR category set is due for this key. Rendered through the repo's intl-messageformat 12.1.3 with the call shape in src/i18n/messages.ts:150 — both arguments substituted, no brace left in the output.
checks.unicode: value === value.normalize("NFC"); no bidi control characters (U+200E/200F/202A-202E/2066-2069/U+061C) — the ur guide forbids inserting them because the render layer isolates; no ZWJ/ZWNJ; no NBSP or narrow NBSP; no leading, trailing or doubled spaces.
checks.who_consented: {actor} is the grammatical subject (or, for ru, the colon topic that supplies the impersonal verb's agent) in this locale, and the target appears as the object or after a dash, so a reader learns who consented and who joined.
checks.sibling_elsewhere: ui.teamBridge.events.consented keeps its wording and still claims no relation (Sana Ketabchi đã đồng ý cho Aida (Sana Ketabchi) tham gia); the new line adds the possessive and nothing else — no negation, no "someone else" — so the non-owner arm keeps its "elsewhere" meaning instead of being narrowed by the new key.
checks.self_approval: « của mình » is the reflexive possessive and its antecedent is the clausal subject, {actor}. The target is introduced by the apposition « là » that FOLLOWS « mình », so the agent name can be neither the antecedent nor the subject of « đồng ý »; a reader cannot get « the agent approved itself » out of it. The reading is also already established for readers by the shipped owner_added_agent line, which uses this exact chunk.
checks.register: Third-person sentence with the sibling's verb (« đã đồng ý cho … tham gia »). No bạn address form appears. NFC verified: every diacritic-bearing word (đã, đồng, ý, tác, nhân, của, mình) are precomposed, per the vi guide's width/rendering rule.
checks.terminology: agent = « tác nhân » (glossary §2 and the vi guide's locale call). « tác nhân của mình là {targets} » reuses that key's chunk « tác nhân của mình là {targets} » verbatim (« đã thêm tác nhân của mình là {targets} »), so the same English « their agent » maps to the same local phrase in both keys.
checks.length: 78 cells at one target with the shipped fixture labels, against English's 63 and the namespace's previous maximum of 63 (ui.teamBridge.events.owner_added_agent).
checks.method: Read the English value, the en sidecar entry in full, this locale's glossary row and style guide, the two shipped precedent keys in this namespace, and the renderer path (team-bridge-member-events.tsx:60-112 and team-bridge-member-events-model.ts:122-197); then executed the real path (esbuild bundle of the model + sentence renderer, real catalogues, setLocale per locale) at one target, at two rolled-up targets, and with an agent actor, and rendered every value with intl-messageformat at one target.

findings.current: {actor} đã đồng ý cho tác nhân của mình là {targets} tham gia
findings.proposed: (unchanged) — this locale's two-target render is number-neutral and correct; the upstream cardinality fix is the renderer's
findings.detail: A consent roll-up (two records sharing one request_id — the grouping key team-bridge-member-events-model.ts:144-156 groups on) produces one line with two targets, and the owner arm renders the possessive singular over the pair: « Sana Ketabchi đã đồng ý cho tác nhân của mình là Aida (Sana Ketabchi) và Scout (Sana Ketabchi) tham gia » — Vietnamese does not mark grammatical number, so this reads correctly. English has the same defect ("their agent A and B"), so this is not a translation error: the sentence's grammatical number depends on a cardinality nothing enforces, and the en sidecar's "always exactly one name for this key" is that unenforced assumption. No local change follows: the only defect on the two-target path is upstream. Reachability: the UI merges these events itself; whether the hub emits two consent records under one request_id is unverified (the server is not deployed and no corpus is readable here).

findings.proposed: if (line.actor.kind !== "human") return false;  /* before the every() test; the cardinality guard is CO-B1 */
findings.detail: The predicate compares account ids but never the actor's kind. An agent party carries its OWNER's account_id (the contract's own statement, restated in the model's docstring), so a consent whose actor is an agent on the same account takes the owner arm and the sentence claims a relation an agent cannot have. Executed: actor = agent "Aida (Sana Ketabchi)", target = agent "Scout (Sana Ketabchi)" renders Aida (Sana Ketabchi) đã đồng ý cho tác nhân của mình là Scout (Sana Ketabchi) tham gia — for this locale the self-approval reading the audit was asked about becomes possible only through this hole, never through the wording. Minor: no readable corpus proves the hub records an agent as the consenting actor; the guard costs one line and makes the predicate match its own docstring ("the actor owns the target").

findings.key: ui.teamBridge.events.consented (en sidecar entry, unchanged by this branch)
findings.current: role: "timeline system line: an agent's owner approved the agent joining"; note: "The owner gave consent for their agent to join this conversation. Reads 'X approved Y joining'."
findings.proposed: role: "timeline system line: a consent the owner arm does not claim (the actor is not the sole owner of every target)"; note: "Reads 'X approved Y joining'. Claims no relation between actor and target (design round 1, D1); the owner's own act reads through ui.teamBridge.events.consented_owner."
findings.detail: The sibling now renders whenever the owner arm's predicate is false — the non-owner case, a mixed group, and (once CO-B1 is fixed) any multi-target group — so its sidecar still tells the next translator the key is the owner's line and invites a possessive into the arm that is designed to claim no relation. This locale's sibling value (Sana Ketabchi đã đồng ý cho Aida (Sana Ketabchi) tham gia) already claims none; only the English context is stale.

findings.current: {actor} đã đồng ý cho tác nhân của mình là {targets} tham gia
findings.proposed: (unchanged) — flag for a rendered check at the timeline column's narrowest supported width
findings.detail: At one target with the shipped fixture labels this is the longest line in the ui.teamBridge.events namespace for this locale: 78 cells against 63 for the previous longest (ui.teamBridge.events.owner_added_agent), i.e. 15 cells over the namespace's previous maximum and 24% over English's 63. The line is rendered in a min-w-0 truncate span (team-bridge-member-events.tsx:144-151), so it ellipsises rather than wraps, and the Tooltip that carries the full list exists only when more than TEAM_BRIDGE_EVENT_NAMES_SHOWN names are truncated — an ellipsised two-name line would hide a name with no affordance. No copy change proposed: every shorter phrasing either drops the "own agent" relation the key exists for or breaks the possessive device already audited in ui.teamBridge.events.owner_added_agent.

verdict.note: No blocker or major in this locale: CO-B1 is an observation here because the two-target render is number-neutral and correct in this language. CO-B2 and CO-B3 are minors on the renderer predicate and the English context; CO-B4 is recorded for completeness.
